title: Raw Ice Ether
description: This is a mod that adds new minerals, equipment, building blocks, and tools
body:
“在冰冷的地底，唯有炽热的以太能照亮前行的路。”

你是否厌倦了在挖矿时背着沉重的熔炉？是否在面对怪物围攻时，渴望手中的利刃能自带烈焰的力量？《火焰以太》模组为你带来了生存体验的质变！

核心特性：

⚔️ 灼热之刃 (Fire Ether Sword)： 这不再是普通的武器。由于注入了纯净的火焰以太，每一击都会让敌人瞬间陷入无尽的火海。无须附魔，它就是火属性的化身。

⛏️ 自动熔炼技术： 使用火焰以太稿或全能工具挖掘铁、金、铜矿石时，炽热的高温会瞬间将其提纯为纯净的金属锭。它足够智能——当你附魔了“精准采集”时，它会收敛高温，为你保留珍贵的原矿。

🪓 全能工具 (Paxcel)： 将稿子的坚硬与斧头的锋利完美融合。它是拾荒者与建筑师的梦幻工具，不仅能瞬间碎石砍木，更是你防身时的火焰重器。

⚙️ 深度兼容： 完美适配 Forge 1.20.1，通过全局战利品修改器 (GLM) 实现，完美兼容时运 (Fortune) 附魔，让你的资源获取翻倍。

踏入火焰的领域，重塑你的世界。

"In the cold underground, only the blazing Ether can illuminate the path ahead."

Are you tired of carrying a heavy smelting furnace when mining? Do you long for a sharp blade that can ignite flames when facing a mob attack? The "Flame Ether" mod brings a qualitative change to your survival experience!

Core features:

⚔️ Fire Ether Sword: This is no ordinary weapon. Infused with pure flame ether, every strike instantly traps enemies in an endless sea of fire. No enchantment required, it is the embodiment of fire.

⛏️ Automatic Smelting Technology: When using the Flame Ether Pick or the Universal Tool to mine iron, gold, and copper ores, the intense heat instantly purifies them into pure metal ingots. It's intelligent enough - when you enchant it with "Precise Harvesting", it will contain the heat and preserve the precious raw ore for you.

🪓 Paxcel: A versatile tool that seamlessly combines the hardness of a manuscript with the sharpness of an axe. It is a dream tool for scavengers and architects, capable of instantly crushing rocks and chopping wood, and also serving as a formidable weapon for self-defense.

⚙️ Deep Compatibility: Perfectly compatible with Forge 1.20.1, achieved through the Global Loot Modifier (GLM), and fully compatible with the Fortune enchantment, doubling your resource acquisition.

Step into the realm of flames and reshape your world.

安装教程：
下载需要的游戏版本，记得安装对应的Forge加载器。打开mod文件夹，拖入mod，启动游戏就可以开始玩啦，不要下载前置mod哦

Installation Tutorial:
Download the required game version and remember to install the corresponding Forge loader. Open the mod folder, drag in the mod, and start the game to begin playing. Do not download prerequisite mods


最后祝你玩的开心
Finally, I wish you a pleasant time
